note: FORNAMN/EFTERNAMN are the same-shape pair that groups in siblings-only-same-shape-non-code-label-siblings-form-a-group. Here the efternamn variable holds two spellings: EFTERNAMN alone in 2019, and Efternamn twice in the same 2020 edition as FORNAMN, once as int and once as text, so the shapes of that one co-delivered edition are disputed: one reading groups the pair, the other does not. Only Efternamn, the spelling that sorts after EFTERNAMN, is co-delivered with FORNAMN (#1760, the DatOvl_2/DATOVL_2 case). In 2021 FORNAMN is delivered again beside an Efternamn (text) that a column_owner gives a third owner, efternamn-2021: that owner shape-conflicts with fornamn and folds with efternamn (the same spelling, never co-delivered), so the one concept group is efternamn/efternamn-2021. The 2021 Efternamn is not efternamn's delivery, so the 2021 edition does not compare FORNAMN with efternamn's Efternamn and the dispute stays the 2020 one (#1760, the iku kommun/kommun-kommkod-2012 case). Values from the replaced test: A int (member 1), B int (member 2), B text (member 3) -> no pairs and an unresolved_shape decision. The decision is reported as the ambiguous_sibling_shape issue; that code is the one the replaced file's withheld-shape test asserts for the same emission. The conflicting_occurrence_facts and unknown_data_type errors on Efternamn are the delivery's own and are not claimed.
fails_if: `resolve_sibling_pairs` (reg_meta_build/src/reg_meta_build/source_siblings.py) only marks a pair unresolved when a shape field is withheld, not when the shapes of one co-delivered edition disagree, or checks co-delivery and shape on one representative column per owner (the lexically first, EFTERNAMN, never co-delivered with FORNAMN), so FORNAMN/efternamn group; or keys co-delivery and shape evidence by column spelling rather than (owner, spelling), so efternamn's Efternamn takes efternamn-2021's 2021 text shape in the 2021 edition, the pair is a plain shape_conflict and no ambiguous_sibling_shape is raised

sources.description: Register 1, variable 300: EFTERNAMN (CVID 1007, int) in 2019; FORNAMN (CVID 1004, int), Efternamn (CVID 1005, int) and Efternamn again (CVID 1006, Sträng (text)) in 2020; FORNAMN (CVID 1008, int) and Efternamn (CVID 1009, Sträng (text)) in 2021.
